# StayGreen Compliance

> StayGreen is an AI-powered procedure management and compliance service for oil & gas operators and contractors. For operators: photograph a paper field JSA and the AI reads the scope, steps, hazards, and sign-in block, matches every step to the operator's governing procedure, and collects each crew member's acknowledgment from their own phone — stamped with time and GPS — into one audit-ready closeout record (pre-work constraints, post-work verifications, per-hand per-revision acknowledgment history). For contractors: ISNetworld, Veriforce, and Avetta compliance in one dashboard, with an AI agent that monitors portals daily, reads training certificates from phone photos, tracks COI endorsement requirements, and alerts before anything turns red.

## What StayGreen does
- Operator procedure management: procedure library built from the operator's catalog (codes, revisions, keywords); paper JSA capture with AI step-to-procedure matching; per-hand acknowledgment links (text, email, QR) with time and GPS; offline procedure copies for no-service pads; closeout records and searchable job history
- Daily monitoring of portal action items, grades, and expiring requirements across ISNetworld, Veriforce, and Avetta
- AI parsing of training qualification (TQ) certificates — SafeLand, H2S, OSHA 10/30, First Aid/CPR, operator-specific orientations — from photos or PDFs
- Certificate-of-insurance (COI) tracking: limits, Additional Insured, Waiver of Subrogation, Primary & Non-Contributory wording; auto-drafted broker request emails
- RAVS safety program tracking and drafting
- Same-day alerts when an operator (Devon, Oxy, Chevron, ConocoPhillips, and others) adds or changes requirements

## Who it's for
Oil & gas operators (E&P, midstream, production) who need field evidence that crews worked to their own procedures — and small and mid-size contractors (compression, roustabout, wireline, hauling, welding) who must stay compliant in ISNetworld, Veriforce, or Avetta without a full-time compliance department. The website defaults to the operator view; a contractor tab carries the contractor story.

## Key facts
- Website: https://staygreencompliance.ai (operator tab default; #contractors deep-links the contractor view)
- Portal: https://app.staygreencompliance.ai
- Service area: Permian Basin, Texas, New Mexico, Oklahoma, and US-wide
